subject: OrbitAI evaluation cadence, success criteria & kickoff confirmation
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@orbitai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@orbitai.com>; procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up — proposed success metrics and timelines

Thanks for the demo earlier — appreciate the crisp walkthrough. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can scope the POC: 

- Primary goals: reduce average triage time for customer support tickets by >=30% (measured on a 30-day sample) and maintain >=92% answer relevance score on our internal rubric.
- Key datasets: last 6 months of anonymized tickets (we can share s3 access), agent chat logs for escalation flows.
- Proposed window: 4-week evaluation (2-week integration + 2-week validation + 1-week readout) — flexible on sequencing.
- Stakeholders: Ava (Product), Miguel (Eng), Procurement (legal & contract).

Can you share a proposed cadence (kickoff date, weekly check-ins, deliverables per week) and the owners on the Redwood side? Also please attach a one-page evaluation matrix so we can confirm measurement.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Chen
Head of Product, OrbitAI
ava@orbitai.com

Attachment: orbitai-goals-brief.pdf (1 page)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@orbitai.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@orbitai.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — proposed success metrics and timelines

Ava — great to meet you and thanks for the clear goals. Proposed lightweight plan below (happy to adjust):

Week 0 (Kickoff) — target Mon Sep 6
- Goal: alignment call + S3 access + identify 3 sample flows
- Owners: Jonas (redwood PL), Miguel (orbitai eng), Marissa (CS)
- Deliverables: integration checklist, sample dataset receipt, success-metric definitions doc (attached: orbitai-eval-success-criteria.docx)

Week 1 (Integration)
- Redwood: deploy evaluation model into your staging, verify KV cache behavior, enable token-level tracing for 2 flows
- OrbitAI: provide datasets and test accounts
- Deliverable: integration verification report

Week 2 (Warm-run)
- Run with live traffic sampling, tune batching/latency knobs, capture relevance labels on 200 tickets
- Deliverable: mid-eval readout (10 min)

Week 3 (Validation)
- Focus on metric windows (triage time, relevance score), run A/B vs baseline, qualitative review with product
- Deliverable: validation report + annotated examples

Week 4 (Readout)
- Final readout, decision checkpoint, next-steps for prod lift (SLA/scale ask)

Cadence: 30-minute weekly sync (Mon 9am PT) + asynchronous updates in shared Drive. I've attached a calendar .ics and an evaluation matrix (evaluation-matrix.xlsx).

Notes on measurement: we'll compute triage-time using ticket updated timestamps (we'll define exact SQLs during kickoff). For relevance scoring, we'll use your rubric but suggest a blind-review of 100 samples by your product team and Redwood CS.

If the dates work, we'll lock kickoff for Mon Sep 6 and I can loop our infra lead if we need earlier networking setup.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

Attachments: orbitai-eval-success-criteria.docx, redwood-eval-schedule.ics, evaluation-matrix.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: OrbitAI POC — owners & pre-kickoff checklist

Jonas / Ben — short internal runbook ahead of kickoff: 

Pre-kickoff (by Fri Sep 3)
- Ben: confirm staging GPU pool and sample model variant (gpt-medium-8q) + quantization profile.
- Marissa: prepare onboarding doc for OrbitAI product reviewers and create Drive folder with evaluation rubric; set up access for Ava/Miguel.
- Jonas: share SQL templates for triage-time computation and confirm RBAC for their S3 bucket.

Risks we should flag in kickoff:
- Data access delays (procurement needs right away)
- Edge-case latency > 800ms on cold starts (we'll gate with warm-up requests)

I'll draft the weekly sync agenda and a one-page escalation playbook (who to call if we see data gaps).

Marissa
Marissa Cole

Thanks — Sep 6 works for the kickoff. A few clarifications from Eng/Procurement: 

- Procurement: we need a short SOW (1 page) that calls out data handling, retention (30 days), and liabilities; procurement@orbitai.com will send a redline template.

- Metrics: for triage time, we want to exclude bot-handled tickets — we'll add a flag in the exported dataset.

If you can add the SOW stub to the Drive, procurement can start a parallel review. We'll also confirm the stakeholder list (Ava, Miguel, 2 product reviewers).

Miguel
